title: Make tadu migrate produce a doctor-clean backlog from legacy TODO_LOG entries
notes: Trial on copies of 73 owned repos: 64 migrate to a backlog with J003 errors (a done task needs closed/result/evidence, titles over 200 characters, an open task with closed). 9 migrated clean. Smallest next step: let migrate fill legacy closed entries (closed from the log date or the migration date, a legacy evidence marker) and cut long titles into notes, then migrate the rest of ~/p.
